steps.text: Starting landscape tile (three connected tiles) in the middle
Shuffle each tier of landscape tiles separately
Tier-2 deck facedown, tier-1 deck on top of it as one deck
All monster army tokens in the bag
Dark General standee, Praetorian tokens and the Plague token by the bag
Resource tray (food, wood, stone and Unit dice) within everyone's reach
Each player: a Hero board, 1 city token, {l} life tokens (heart up) and 6 building tokens (grey side up) on their spaces
Shuffle the 6 Hero cards facedown; each player draws 1 onto their board; box the rest
steps.note: Or choose heroes in die-roll order

steps.text: Your Hero's city token in front of you, grey (unbuilt) side up
2 actions per turn; before each action you may move 1 tile
